title: react-instantsearch triggers unnecessary requests when everything is unmounted
body:
Hello everybody,

When all react-instantsearch components/widgets are unmounted (for instance, in case of route change), many unnecessary search requests are triggered by react-instantsearch. The below fiddle triggers an unmounting of the whole tree below the `InstantSearch` component after 1s.

Steps:

1. Open https://jsfiddle.net/uza8mda0/1/
2. Open network tab, filter for XHR requests
3. Click `play` button, wait for >= 1s
4. Observe that 4 requests have been triggered in total, instead of one.

**Bug: What is the current behavior?** Unnecessary requests are triggered when everything is unmounted, even with cache enabled on the algolia client

**Bug: What is the expected behavior?** Unmounting everything doesn't trigger any request.

**What project are you opening an issue for?**

* react-instantsearch

**What is the version you are using? Always use the latest one before opening a bug issue.** 3.2.1
